summary: The current model shows significant overfitting with an 8% train-validation accuracy gap (70.77% vs 62.90%). Validation metrics have degraded compared to baseline: accuracy dropped from 68.01% to 62.90%, Brier increased from 0.2157 to 0.2205, and AUC decreased from 0.733 to 0.694. Feature analysis reveals 15+ near-zero importance features (<5) that should be removed to reduce overfitting. The model relies heavily on striking volume control (top 2 features), age difference, and takedown ability. Top 25% confidence predictions show 79.19% accuracy (baseline), and underdog betting is profitable (121% ROI on top 10% confidence). Key priority: prune low-importance features and increase regularization to close the train-validation gap.
